name: sgct
description: This manifest is used when building SGCT standalone from this checkout. See the port under support/vcpkg/ports/sgct declaring the same runtime dependencies for consumers.

stbimage (compiled stb_image/stb_image_write implementation, shared with Ghoul to avoid duplicate-symbol/ODR problems when both are linked into the same program) lives in its own repository (https://github.com/sgct/stbimage). Ghoul and the OpenSpace superproject consume it as a git submodule, but SGCT instead builds it through the support/vcpkg/ports/stbimage overlay port, which fetches the same pinned commit directly from GitHub, so that SGCT keeps building from vcpkg alone with no extra submodule to initialize.

ndi.description: Build SGCT with NDI support. Proprietary SDK, the resulting package cannot be redistributed

scalable.description: Build SGCT with Scalable SDK support. Proprietary SDK, the resulting package cannot be redistributed
